title: D class (v11 D1-D9 and review R10): documents claimed more than the evidence showed
what_went_wrong: Manifest overclaims (D1, D2), the R5 edge-strata statement (D3), the handoff 'no grants' line resting on a vacuous probe (D4), a per-encounter bound labelled otherwise (D5), the E6 sign (D6), the P14 rubric score (D7), the run-lock release (D8), the P12 'one held lock' wording (D9). In P15 itself: 'RUNLOCK-FREE at P15 start' and the 'ae5da20e' line hash had no file behind them, and the 'partly true' count did not match the table.
root_cause: Statements were carried forward from earlier waves or written from memory of the run, not from a named evidence file.
detection: Astra v11 D1-D9; independent P15 review R10-R12.
impact: Readers could rely on a state the record did not show.

correction.applied: Strike-through with reasons (P15 D1-D9); P16 D1-D3: the unevidenced P15 claims struck, the count recomputed, the grant-line hash reproduced from the evidence files (evidence/p16/grant_line_hashes_p15.txt), the lock state captured before acquisition and after release.

rule: A claim in a record cites a file and a line, or it is not made.
